name: ball_m8_tap
description: Sphere with an M8 tapped bore on the pole — semantic surface targeting on a fully curved skin (the case that produced the freehand Pos*tap placement).

stages.prompt:
Solid steel ball, parametric, mm units. Sphere diameter 60, resting on the XY plane, centred in X and Y (top pole at z=60).
- One M8 tapped (internal thread, M8x1.25) blind bore, 25 mm deep, opening exactly at the top pole, axis along Z, normal to the surface.
No other features.
